title: TypeScript provider request options for sqlPlan
description: The options member of the admitted canonical request, mirrored from the provider's own validation for the source-to-SQL planning operation.

source.detail: no secondary source: the options member is admitted and normalized by validateRequest alone, and the operation binding at (:200-210) is what makes the database and client members required here

sourceContract.drift: validateRequest is the authority and this document is its admitted mirror: a change to those lines requires a change here. Allowed keys are exactly OPTION_KEYS (:54, rejectUnknownKeys :158-162); the keys the C engine owns are refused by name for this engine (:55, :161-163); project defaults to the empty string when absent (:161); every read root is a nonempty string (:164-170); database admits the two DATABASE_ENGINES only (:74, :171-189) and carries path for sqlite-schema and connectionFile for postgres-schema; client carries a nonempty path with line and column defaulting to zero (:190-198).

operationBinding.detail: a databaseAccesses selection performs this operation and sets needsDatabase, and the request then requires both the database and the client member, refusing with context-database-path-missing or context-typescript-client-missing when either is absent

sourceContract.identityNote: no $id is set: the admitted identity is a hole for package admission to fill, named by the inventory it admits.

crossFieldRules.detail: both members are present for this operation, and their absence refuses with the condition that names the missing one
the keys of options are exactly OPTION_KEYS; a C-only key refuses with context-option-unsupported-for-engine and any other refuses with context-option-unknown
requireU32 admits a safe integer from 0 to 0xffffffff, and nothing else
requireNonEmptyString admits a string of length at least one, and nothing else
